results.evidence: **Subgroup analyses.** Tsai and colleagues' pre-specified subgroups map directly onto the three splits requested. By age, the systolic BP-lowering effect was significantly more pronounced among trials enrolling participants aged 60 years and older than in younger populations, and heterogeneity was lower within the older-age subgroup. By sample size, trials with fewer than 300 participants showed a larger-magnitude systolic BP reduction than trials with 300 or more participants.
